subject: session date
fact: The events occur in the context of a murder investigation at Candlekeep, with no explicit in-world calendar date provided.

subject: drow soldiers count
fact: No drow soldiers or similar creatures are mentioned in the text.

subject: Candlekeep library layout
fact: Candlekeep is described as very easy to get lost in.
source_quote: The library is very easy to get lost in.

subject: number of investigators
fact: There are four investigators: Daz, Grygum, Thorin, and Zalthir.
source_quote: four, five, seven, eight, ten of us

subject: sequence of investigation steps
fact: The group decides to start together and split later when two doors open at once.
source_quote: we'd start together and peel off when two doors opened at once

subject: poison sample value
fact: A sample of poison was taken from the victim's fingers and lip, but no monetary value is assigned.
source_quote: a sample of the stuff — off his fingers, and his lip too

subject: impersonation thread
fact: Someone impersonated Sylvira Savikas, walking the halls at night with a lantern.
source_quote: Someone impersonating her

subject: missing book fragment thread
fact: A missing part of a book, possibly from a hundred years ago, is noted as suspicious and potentially related.
source_quote: There's a missing part of, like, a book that should not be missing… that could have happened a hundred years ago or something

subject: tower key thread
fact: Kalan Strongbranch may still possess his other tower key, a key thread to pursue.
source_quote: I'm more curious if he still has his other tower key

subject: time of Fheminor's beating
fact: Fheminor Scrivenbark was beaten up at eight in the morning, which is a key timing detail.
source_quote: find out when the man got beaten up, because beat-up-at-eight tells a different story

subject: sequence of council meeting
fact: The Council of the Great Readers dispersed before the investigators arrived, and the body was taken to the Shrine of Oghma after the meeting.
source_quote: The Council of the Great Readers had dispersed. We came into the chapter house to find her already in conference with someone new... The body went to be purified.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: Deneir's Sanctum is offered as the investigators' office, a shrine and library dedicated to the art of writing.
source_quote: Deneir's Sanctum, a little shrine and library given over to the art of writing

subject: lantern ownership
fact: A lantern was carried by the impersonator of Sylvira Savikas during nighttime movements.
source_quote: Sylvira — or somebody wearing her face — had been walking the halls in the dead of night with a lantern

subject: sequence of witness interviews
fact: Daz is assigned to interview Fheminor Scrivenbark first, as he has the least amount of time or talk.
source_quote: Daz took Fheminor. 'I'm looking at the ones that have the least amount of time, or probably have the least amount to talk about'

subject: number of people at council meeting
fact: At least seven individuals are named as present at the council meeting: A'lai Aivenmore, Fheminor Scrivenbark, Kazryn Nyantani, Alkrist, Bookwyrm, Daral, and Zalthir.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore wanting a vote and new leadership. The dowdy halfling, Fheminor Scrivenbark, asking whether Janussi had named a successor. Kazryn Nyantani — slender, gray, those wrinkles around the eyes — cutting through with first you must find the murderer. The bronze dragonborn, Alkrist, formidable and furious... Bookwyrm trying to settle the room. And Daral not even in it

subject: Shrine of Oghma
fact: The body is taken to the Shrine of Oghma for purification.
source_quote: take the body to the Shrine of Oghma for purification

subject: duration of investigation constraint
fact: The investigators are told they will only get to chase a handful of threads before the investigation moves on without them.
source_quote: the constraint landed — that we'd only get to chase a handful of threads before the thing moved on without us

subject: sequence of suspect elimination
fact: Daral and Sylvira are crossed off as suspects based on gut feeling, not evidence.
source_quote: Daral, we crossed off — not by evidence, by gut... Sylvira, same logic, different reason

subject: corpse interrogation claim
fact: Kalan claimed they tried to question the corpse, but it didn't work because the mouth was locked shut.
source_quote: Kalan said they'd put the question to the corpse, and that it didn't work. And that didn't work because of Y. The imposter — the false devil-lady — supposedly did it first and locked the corpse's mouth shut for days.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: poison delivery method
fact: Midnight tears poison is ingested and activates at midnight, with color change upon contact with saliva.
source_quote: The dust stays pale ochre. What darkens it is saliva.

subject: sapphire spell function
fact: The sapphire summoning spell retrieves a hidden object to the caster's hand, regardless of location.
source_quote: You can put it someplace, you can throw it into a river or whatever. Nobody will find it, and then when you need it back, boom.

subject: High Tower entrance
fact: The High Tower is the entrance to all super-magical artifacts, always watched, entry always visible.
source_quote: The tower is watched. Always. People stand at it whether the key is in someone's pocket or not.

subject: key transfer
fact: Kalan transferred the second High Tower key to someone who is not himself, and now holds no key.
source_quote: I have given it now to someone who is not me.

subject: locket key storage
fact: The key was carried in a locket worn around the neck, now missing.
source_quote: The key was in the locket. The locket was around the keeper's neck. The locket was gone.

subject: murderer's method
fact: The murderer is a magic user who can circumvent arcane and mundane locks with talking magic.
source_quote: Magic that could talk any lock open, arcane or iron, the very highest order of that art.

subject: murder timing
fact: The victim died at midnight after ingesting midnight tears poison, likely via licking a poisoned page.
source_quote: He died at roughly midnight. His fingers were black, his lips were black.

subject: Flora Theca location
fact: The Flora Theca is a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis within the Great Library, dedicated to plants and herbs.
source_quote: The Flora Theca, a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis, inside the Great Library, dedicated to plants, herbs, and other flora.

subject: midnight tears poison origin
fact: Midnight tears is a highly toxic pale ochre dust made from Feywild pollen, lethal unless neutralized by specific Feywild sap.
source_quote: A highly toxic pale ochre dust, made from the pollen of a plant usually found only in the Feywild.

subject: false identity
fact: Someone impersonated Sylvira Savikas the night of the murder.
source_quote: Is he aware that someone was pretending to be Sylvira Savikas the night of the murder?

subject: Hearth interrogation venue
fact: The suspect Daral Yashenti chose the Hearth as the venue for interrogation, asserting control over the setting.
source_quote: Daral was not coming to us. We were to go to the Hearth.

subject: investigator collaboration
fact: Kalan proposed a private sync-up meeting with five streams to merge findings and resolve contradictions.
source_quote: A meeting to examine everything one by one, the four of us and him, five streams, merge it all in a few hours.

subject: key carry definition
fact: Worn objects are not considered 'carried' for the purpose of the sapphire summoning spell.
source_quote: It doesn't, as it turned out. Which reframed the whole use.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 11th day of the month, during the interrogation of Daral Yashenti at the Hearth.
source_quote: The eleven o'clock meeting came out without resistance

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: bookwyrm count
fact: Bookwyrm is a lizard-like entity that eats its young, as described in the interrogation.
source_quote: There's no telling what's going on in her lizard brain. Cold-blooded, he went on, they eat their young, murdering crowbait like Janussi.

subject: assault on Janussi
fact: Daral may have caught Janussi lightly on the nose during a physical altercation.
source_quote: Daral may have caught him lightly on the nose

subject: Whispering Dome
fact: The Whispering Dome is a quiet, low-light chamber where supplicants learn about themselves.
source_quote: The Whispering Dome was the kind of place I would have liked under different circumstances. Quiet. Low light pooling under the curve of the ceiling.

subject: poisoned book value
fact: The book used to carry poison was one of Daral's favorite volumes, licked by the killer.
source_quote: The poison carried on a book, transferred by a man licking his finger and turning the pages.

subject: glabbagool presence
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze entity that bonds with Zalthir, granting teleportation, acidic shadow key, and corrosive embrace.
source_quote: Glabbagool and Zalthir, together now... He could teleport in darkness... He could force his acidic shadow key into a wound. And a corrosive embrace...

subject: silent communication lesson
fact: Zalthir missed the lesson on silent communication, while Glabbagool mastered it by going still.
source_quote: If I had paid more attention to the classes on silent communication, I would know exactly what Glabbagool's answer meant... He had mastered the one lesson I most thoroughly missed, and he had done it in under a minute, by going still.

subject: bag of holding
fact: The bag of holding contains drow that require monitoring, per Glabbagool's instruction.
source_quote: the drow in the bag of holding still needed watching

subject: drow overseer count
fact: Drow in the context of prisoner labor are overseers, not workers.
source_quote: Drow named in connection with prisoner labor are overseers, not workers.

subject: midnight curfew
fact: Daral will be kept under watch until midnight, when a cleric and sword capable of drawing poison are within arm's reach.
source_quote: We'd keep Daral close until midnight — a cleric who could draw poison out, and a sword that could do the same, both within arm's reach.

subject: book page flicking
fact: Daral flicked through the pages of the poisoned book with his finger, indicating direct contact with the poison.
source_quote: he wet his finger and began flicking through the pages

subject: teles count
fact: Teles is a deluded old git among the suspects in Daral’s interrogation.
source_quote: Teles, the deluded old git

subject: a'lai count
fact: A'lai Aivenmore is a preying cock among the suspects in Daral’s interrogation.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore, the preying cock

subject: fheminor count
fact: Fheminor Scrivenbark is a small-statured but steely-natured suspect in Daral’s interrogation.
source_quote: Fheminor Scrivenbark, don't be fooled by her stature, she has a steely nature

subject: blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a location Glabbagool survived during his history.
source_quote: He had survived Blingdenstone and the ooze crisis

subject: glabbagool bonding
fact: Glabbagool bonded with Zalthir by settling along his forearm, appearing as part of his scales.
source_quote: Glabbagool flowed up onto my arm... settling along my forearm like he had measured it in advance

subject: glabbagool eyes count
fact: Glabbagool has four eyes on Zalthir’s arm, which Zalthir later requested to blend into his scales.
source_quote: Four, as it turned out, blinking up from my own scales... Maybe he can just look more like my normal — scales, whatever I have.

subject: drow poisoning timeline
fact: The poison was transferred via a book licked by the killer, and the act occurred during a day of drugging and emotional distress.
source_quote: I was drugged. I was upset. I don't know what I was thinking.

subject: silent communication mastery
fact: Glabbagool mastered silent communication by going still, while Zalthir had missed the lesson.
source_quote: He had mastered the one lesson I most thoroughly missed, and he had done it in under a minute, by going still.
